mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spectra_core.scheduler_execution ( id, job_id, fire_key, trigger_type, status, job_revision, handler_version, schedule_kind_snapshot, schedule_expression_snapshot, parameters_snapshot, effect_type, scheduled_at, queued_at, started_at, finished_at, next_retry_at, deadline_at, attempt_no, max_attempts, locked_by, locked_at, lease_expires_at, last_heartbeat_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, result_summary, original_execution_id, resolution_status, resolution_reason, resolved_by, resolved_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted, version ) VALUES ( #{execution.id}, #{execution.jobId}, #{execution.fireKey}, #{execution.triggerType}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.jobRevision}, #{execution.handlerVersion}, #{execution.scheduleKindSnapshot}, #{execution.scheduleExpressionSnapshot}, #{execution.parametersSnapshot, typeHandler=com.devops00.spectra.common.mybatis.PgJsonbTypeHandler}, #{execution.effectType}, #{execution.scheduledAt}, #{execution.queuedAt}, #{execution.startedAt}, #{execution.finishedAt}, #{execution.nextRetryAt}, #{execution.deadlineAt}, #{execution.attemptNo}, #{execution.maxAttempts}, #{execution.lockedBy}, #{execution.lockedAt}, #{execution.leaseExpiresAt}, #{execution.lastHeartbeatAt}, #{execution.lastErrorCode}, #{execution.lastErrorMessage}, #{execution.resultSummary, typeHandler=com.devops00.spectra.common.mybatis.PgJsonbTypeHandler}, #{execution.originalExecutionId}, #{execution.resolutionStatus}, #{execution.resolutionReason}, #{execution.resolvedBy}, #{execution.resolvedAt}, #{execution.createdBy}, #{execution.createdAt}, #{execution.updatedBy}, #{execution.updatedAt}, #{execution.deleted}, #{execution.version} ) ON CONFLICT (fire_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spectra_core.scheduler_execution WHERE ((status = 'QUEUED' AND scheduled_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now})) ORDER BY scheduled_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_execution SET status = 'UNKNOWN', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at < #{now}

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_execution SET status = #{status}, attempt_no = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RETRY_WAIT' THEN attempt_no + 1 ELSE attempt_no END, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, result_summary = #{resultSummary, typeHandler=com.devops00.spectra.common.mybatis.PgJsonbTypeHandler}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_by = #{instanceId} AND lease_expires_at >= COALESCE(#{finishedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', locked_by = #{instanceId}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lockedAt}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{lockedAt}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_execution SET status = 'CANCELLED', last_error_code = 'MANUALLY_CANCELLED', last_error_message = #{reason}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY_WAIT')

UPDATE spectra_core.scheduler_execution SET resolution_status = #{resolutionStatus}, resolution_reason = #{reason}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'UNKNOWN' AND resolution_status = 'UNRESOLVED'
